name: Realization of the ITS-90 from 3 K to 24.5561 K with a 3He/4He interpolating constant-volume gas thermometer
plain_name: Measure very low temperatures from the pressure of helium gas sealed in a copper bulb
description: A bulb of about 1 L of OFHC copper, filled with helium and surrounded by an isothermal shield, is calibrated at three points. It is then used to calibrate rhodium-iron thermometers.
keywords: Measure very low temperatures from the pressure of helium gas sealed in a copper bulb

sources.citation: BIPM CCT Guide to the Realization of the ITS-90: Interpolating Constant-Volume Gas Thermometry (2018)

reported_equipment: OFHC copper gas-thermometer bulb with isothermal shield

requirements.rationale: The gas thermometer defines the scale from 3 K to 24.5561 K.
The bulb has to reach 3 K.

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
